summary: DDC Enterprise Limited filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of Series A 13.5% Perpetual Cumulative Preferred Shares at $20.00 per share, against a $25.00 stated value and initial liquidation preference. Investors may pay in cash or non-cash digital assets converted to dollars at closing. Dividends accrue at 13.5% ($3.375 annually) with contingent Bitcoin-linked bonus dividends up to $4.00 per share. Closing requires at least 1,200,000 shares sold and a concurrent underwritten offering of at least 200,000 shares. This is an ordinary preferred-equity capital raise, not a special situation.
